subject.title: feat(codex): fork upstream-linked sessions at a message via thread/fork

question: Should OpenClaw make `AgentHarness.sessionFork` plus public upstream-link registry mutations a supported cross-plugin SDK contract, or keep this follow-up behind a narrower owner-approved seam?
rationale: The patch intentionally expands exported plugin APIs for one harness implementation, and repository policy treats plugin API changes as compatibility-sensitive product direction rather than routine mechanical review.

options.title: Approve the generic harness contract
options.body: Keep the generic capability and registry exports, with explicit compatibility coverage and owner-approved documentation of the contract.

options.title: Narrow the seam first
options.body: Refactor the implementation behind a smaller existing owner boundary if maintainers do not intend other harness plugins to depend on these exports.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic harness contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic capability and registry exports, with explicit compatibility coverage and owner-approved documentation of the contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history links this contributor to both the merged general fork flow and the proposed Codex-specific extension.
